issues: No independently controlled protected holdout evaluation has been executed.
This is a development digital twin, not a released operational controller.
Independent water-utility, controls, and safety review remains outstanding.
limitations: Development and protected-at-execution scenario PASS do not constitute MNCS-L5 PASS.
No physical-system or industrial-protocol evidence is in scope.

issues: The evaluator is hash-locked before runtime scenario generation but is not independently controlled.
Release authority and final operational candidate selection are not established.
limitations: The checked-in preregistration governs a development epoch only.
No D3 process claim is made by this record.

invalidation_triggers: Plant dynamics, pump characteristics, timestep, actual-demand accounting, or terminal normalization changes.
Any safety threshold, dwell rule, telemetry rule, disposition reporting, or authority boundary changes.
The EdgeStream frame contract, adapter mapping, component identity, or Remote Water telemetry contract changes.
Any locked evaluator source, threshold, candidate, simulator, or scenario generator changes.
Holdout disclosure, evaluator change, threshold change, or candidate regeneration.

authorities.role: development repository owner and current evaluator

unresolved_unknowns: Independent water-utility and controls-engineering contract review.
Independently controlled protected holdout outcome and evaluator independence.
Real-time behavior and any physical-system calibration.
Any future mapping to a real installation, PLC, SCADA system, or safety policy.

deviations.rationale: The epoch-2 workflow freezes evaluator identities and generates exact scenarios only after commit on separate x64 and ARM64 virtual machines, but repository ownership and evaluator authority remain correlated.
deviations.risk: Development results may still overestimate generalization or omit domain-specific failure modes.

limitations: This assurance case intentionally records UNKNOWN rather than promoting development evidence to a formal claim.
The code cannot emit live industrial control traffic and must remain development-only.

revalidation_triggers: Any source, generated planner, contract, scenario generator, threshold, simulator, adapter, or checkpoint change.
Assignment of an independent evaluator or creation of an independently controlled protected holdout.
Any proposal to connect the system to live equipment or industrial protocols.

retirement_triggers: A materially simpler implementation satisfies the same accepted requirements.

disposition.rationale: The development harness is executable, cross-architecture, and bounded, but formal implementation and process claims remain UNKNOWN.
